title: CrawlerForge pack file
description: A CrawlerForge content pack file, schema version 106. A field marked x-crawlerforge-fill may be left out: the app fills it in on import (an empty value, or the import time).

schemaVersion.description: The pack file format's version this file is written in. An older version is migrated forward on import.

id.description: The file's own id. Import does not keep it: the pieces join the collection, and if any piece or pack id is already there, every incoming id is replaced with a fresh one.

name.description: A name for the file as a whole. Import brings in its pieces, not this name.

version.description: The file's version number, starting at 1. Import records it on each piece as the version it came from.

description.description: Notes on what the file holds, for whoever opens it.

id.description: The author's account id, when the app wrote the file.

displayName.description: The author's name, as shown with their work.

provenance.description: homebrew for anything a person made. official is reserved for the app's own content.

license.description: The terms the content is shared under: CC-BY-SA-4.0, private, or external for content converted from an outside source.

cover.description: The file's cover picture: a stock image id (stock:name) or the 43-character id of an uploaded image.

coverCredit.description: Who made the cover picture, for an uploaded one.

by.description: The artist's name, shown as the image's credit.

url.description: A link to the artist's work, an ordinary web page starting with http:// or https://.

skills.description: Skills: attacks, Spells, utility Skills and Damage Effects. Skill names are unique in the file, whatever their case.

races.description: Races: what a Crawler was born, hatched or assembled as.

classes.description: Classes: what the dungeon decided a Crawler is for.

gearSets.description: Gear sets: items worn together for bonuses that grow with each piece worn.

tables.description: Charts: tables to roll on or read from, such as Backgrounds, Experience lists, shops and outcomes.

lootBoxes.description: Loot boxes: what is in them.

mobs.description: Mobs: everything that wants a Crawler dead.

scenarios.description: Scenarios: Neighborhoods and Quests, each a place or a plot with its Mobs, traps and rewards.

factions.description: Factions: guilds, gangs, churches and corporations.

debuffs.description: Debuffs of the author's own making, with their rules.

houseRules.description: House rules: the rules a table plays by, in its own words, with the Charts they roll on.

companions.description: Companions: pets and mounts a Crawler can take into the dungeon.

vehicles.description: Vehicles: cars, carts and war rigs.

vehicleUpgrades.description: Vehicle upgrades: things to bolt on to a vehicle.

sounds.description: Sounds: stings, jingles and hits for a table's Soundboard.

neighborhoodMaps.description: Neighborhood maps: rooms painted on the Floor grid.

battleMaps.description: Battle maps: a picture with a grid, for one fight.

tracks.description: Tracks: music for a table's Soundboard.

packs.description: The Forge packs in the file, each a named group of its pieces.

category.description: Category: an Attack Skill, a Spell, a Utility Skill, or a Damage Effect (a Passive Skill added to a hand-to-hand attack).

passive.description: A Passive Skill: it works without being used. A Damage Effect is always one.

interrupt.description: An Interrupt: usable out of turn, in the Crawler Reaction Phase. A keyword the player reads; the rules never act on it.

stat.description: The Stat its Check uses, or none for a Skill with no Stat of its own, such as a Damage Effect.

checkType.description: Check Type: how it is rolled. evade is an attack rolled against the target's Evade; none is a Skill with no roll at all.

opposedBy.description: Opposed by: on an Opposed Skill, the Stat the other side opposes with (an Int-Opposed Check). Left out, the GM picks.

animation.description: The animation it plays when used. Left out, the app picks one.

shield.description: A shield a Skill that is not a Spell gives its user, or one Crawler they pick: when used without a roll, or on a success. A Spell's goes in its spell block.

mod.description: A Stat whose Mod gives the number, read from the caster at cast time and kept in the shield.

slots.description: How many slots the shield has: a fixed number, or a Stat Mod.

fixed.description: A fixed value for each slot.

value.description: Value of each slot: the damage it takes to break one. A hit breaks a slot per full value, and whatever is left below the next slot's value is stopped.

blocks.description: The damage it blocks: all damage, non-magic damage or magic damage.

lasts.description: How long the shield lasts: a number of rounds or minutes, or until ended.

covers.description: Who gets it: self, one Crawler the user chooses, or area (the user and allies in the area, a Spell's only).

byRank.description: The shield's slots from an Upgrade on, replacing the base.

ridesOn.description: Rides on attacks: a Utility Skill that adds to other Skills' attacks instead of rolling its own.

macros.description: Macros it rolls when used, each a whole copy of the macro with when it fires.

species.description: Who can take it: only human or only animal Crawlers. Left out, any Crawler.

die.description: The die it is rolled with. Left out, the Chart has no die: a list to pick or pool from, not to roll.

fromFloor.description: On an Experience list only: it is offered to Crawlers arriving on this Floor or deeper. Left out, to every arrival from the Third Floor on.

buysAt.description: On a Shop Chart only: the percent of a listed price its merchant pays when buying. Left out, 50.

id.description: The column's id, which rows key their cells by.

degree.description: On an outcome Chart with no die, the degree this row is for, each degree once.

rank.description: The Rank it grants, or a die rolled for it. Left out on an Experience row (the pick order decides) or a Background row (the category's Rank).

link.description: The one piece this row points at. A link to a Chart chains to it.

kind.description: The kind of piece it points at: an item, a Debuff, an achievement, a Mob, or a Chart (tables).

id.description: The piece's id.

price.description: A Shop row's price in whole gold.

stock.description: A Shop row's stock. Left out, unlimited.

on.description: self aims the action at whoever rolled the macro. Left out, it aims at the macro's target.

squares.description: Squares the token moves, one by one. It stops early at a wall or the map's edge.

direction.description: The way it moves: one of the eight compass points, north being the top of the map.

on.description: self aims the action at whoever rolled the macro. Left out, it aims at the macro's target.

actions.description: What the app does when this outcome comes up.

outcomes.description: What the roll can lead to: by range on a dice step, by degree on a Skill Check step. A result no outcome covers does nothing.

range.description: The range, low then high, the dice step before must have rolled in.

degree.description: The degree the Skill Check before must have met: success is met by success or better, amazingSuccess by an Amazing Success, failure by a failure only.

imageCredit.description: Who made the picture, for an uploaded one.

by.description: The artist's name, shown as the image's credit.

url.description: A link to the artist's work, an ordinary web page starting with http:// or https://.

origin.description: Origin: an Earth or an Alien Race. An Earth Class is for Earth Races only.

size.description: The size the Race card shows; left out, Size Unchanged. A size effect in the Build is what changes a Crawler's size.

name.description: The size's name: Tiny, Small, Petite, Medium, Large, Huge, Colossal or Gargantuan.

value.description: The size's step on the ladder: Tiny is 1, Medium 4, Gargantuan 8.

prerequisites.description: Prerequisites in words, shown on the Race. With no requirements beside it, the player confirms it by hand at Selection.

requirements.description: Prerequisites the app can check. Selection ticks each one off for a Crawler taking this Race; the prerequisites text stays as written.

chartIds.description: The Charts, by id, the Crawler sees under this Race on their sheet. A Chart with a die gets a Roll button there.

budget.description: The Build Points a Race spends. Detriments earn up to 5 more; points left unspent are lost.

Race.description: A Race: its origin, its size, and the Build of Benefits and Detriments a Crawler takes with it.

examples.name: Vent Gremlin
examples.description: Lives in the ductwork, eats the dust bunnies, resents the dust bunnies.

kind.description: What it checks: a Skill's Rank, a Stat, Popularity, an Achievement, the species, or text the player confirms by hand.
named is one Skill by name; choice is one Skill the player picks; group is every Skill in a group.

name.description: The Skill's name, matched whatever its case across every pack the player holds.

label.description: The group in words, such as all Edged Weapon Skills. A requirement shows the app's own words for the group instead.

by.description: What the group's Skills share: a tag, a Stat, a weapon category, a Skill category or a damage type; all is every Skill.

tag.description: The tag every Skill in the group carries, whatever its case.

stat.description: The Stat every Skill in the group is based on.

category.description: The weapon category (bashing, edged and so on) or the Skill category (attack, spell, utility) every Skill in the group has.

damageType.description: The damage type every Skill in the group deals.

group.description: The group: every Skill in it is meant.

skills.description: The Skills, each by name or as a group. Any one of them at the Rank meets it.

rank.description: The Rank one of those Skills must reach, as the sheet shows it (Rank equal to the Floor counts).

min.description: The least it must be: the Stat's score (with Stat Points placed at Selection), or the Crawler's Popularity.

name.description: An Achievement the Crawler must have earned, by name, whatever its case.

is.description: What the Crawler must be: a human or an animal Crawler.

text.description: A requirement in words. The app cannot check it, so the player confirms it by hand at Selection.

Requirement.description: A prerequisite of a Race or Class the app can check against a Crawler. Selection ticks each one off as met or not.

id.description: The entry's id, unique across the Build's Benefits and Detriments. A Crawler's choices for the entry are kept under it.

name.description: A short name shown before the text, such as Darkvision. Left out, the text leads.

tier.description: Tier, which prices it per point or step: minor 1, moderate 2, major 3, extreme 4, epic 6 Build Points each (+2 Dexterity at minor costs 2). custom has a cost of its own.

cost.description: Cost in Build Points: what a Benefit spends, or what a Detriment earns back.

text.description: What it gives or takes, as the player reads it (+2 Dexterity).

flavor.description: Flavor text, shown after the text.

effects.description: What the sheet does with it. Left empty, the entry is words the player reads.

template.description: The Build catalog entry it was configured from, so the Forge can rebuild its effects. A hand-written entry leaves it out.

id.description: The id of the Build catalog entry it came from.

params.description: The answers given to that catalog entry's questions, by name. override true keeps a tier and cost changed by hand.

BuildEntry.description: One Benefit or Detriment in a Build: its words, its cost in Build Points, and the effects the sheet applies.

type.description: Which effect this is; the fields beside it depend on it.

stat.description: The Stat it works on: the one it raises, caps or uses, by kind. On a consume, a permanent raise: the Stat and how much.

amount.description: How much, by kind: Stat points, DR, Mana added to a cost, damage, Evade, Health slots or Max Mana. Negative is a penalty where allowed.

percent.description: On statPercent, the percent of the Stat given; it becomes points when the item is received. On stat, set by the app to that percent; a hand-written file leaves it out.

allStats.description: On an item's own effects: the amount goes to every Stat, and stat is ignored.

perPatch.description: On an item's own effects: this much more for each patch on the item. A Back Patch doubles the whole bonus.

skill.description: The Skill it applies to: by name, a choice or a group. An inherentSpell names its Spell; a macro fires on that Skill's attacks. On a consume, a name and ranks.

value.description: The size's step on the ladder: Tiny is 1, Medium 4, Gargantuan 8.

name.description: A name: the size's (Large), a natural attack's (Talons) or a Buff's.

feet.description: Feet added to Move, to the movement mode named in mode, or to a step. Negative takes away.

mode.description: For Move, a movement mode (swim, burrow, fly, jump), not added to walking; left out, walking. For a roll mode or on a ride-on's Check, Advantage or Disadvantage.

plusFloor.description: Adds the Floor number too: DR or damage equal to the Floor has amount 0.

damageType.description: The damage type it responds to, or that a natural attack deals.

response.description: Resistance, Immunity or Vulnerability to that damage type.

scope.description: Which it covers: for a Mana cost, the Spells in words (Spells not Favored by this Class); for a roll mode or a bonus die, which rolls.

club.description: A club's name: one the holder belongs to, or one they can never join.

bonus.description: +1 to that Skill's Advancement roll, or Advantage on it.

box.description: The id of a Loot box in the Race's or Class's own pack to give instead; left out, the stock box.

rule.description: must or cannot: whether the holder must worship a deity (or hold a Patron), or cannot.

type.description: debuffImmunity (one Debuff) or debuffFamilyImmunity (a family of Debuffs, or all of them).

debuff.description: The Debuff: for debuffImmunity, the one it is immune to (a stock Debuff's id or a name); on a consume, the one it adds, or a homebrew Debuff's copy.

family.description: The Debuff family it is immune to (mindControl, fear, poison), or all for every Debuff.

rank.description: The Rank: the one skillAtLeast raises the Skill to, or the one an inherentSpell's Spell is cast at, free of Mana.

elseRanks.description: Ranks added instead when the Skill is already at that Rank or higher.

condition.description: When it applies, in words shown to the player.

die.description: The die: a bonus d4 or d6, or a natural attack's damage die.

on.description: Where the Stat replaces the usual one: on the Check, the damage, or both.

total.description: Points the Crawler spreads over the listed Stats at creation.

stats.description: The Stats the pool's points may go to, each once.

max.description: The most that Stat can reach.

count.description: Hands in all, shown as Main Hand, Off Hand, then Hand 3 and up.

slots.description: Lose this many Health Bar slots or more in one blow and the attacker loses one.

text.description: What happens on an Amazing Success with the weapon (its AS line).

types.description: The damage types the amount is split evenly across, each once.

cooldown.description: inherentSpell: how often the Spell can be cast. Older files hold it as text, which still reads.

notes.description: The Buff's notes, shown with it.

effects.description: What the Buff gives, never another Buff.

perFloor.description: Once per Floor: the player uses it to restore Health (recovery) or Mana (restore), once each Floor.

perFloorAmount.description: How much it restores: Health Bar slots for recovery, Mana points for restore. Left out, in full.

heal.description: Heals: Health Bar slots restored when it is used, or full.

mends.description: Mends: minor ends a Minor Injury, major a Minor or Major Injury (the worst first), all every Injury.

pet.description: The heal goes to a pet the player picks, not to the Crawler.

stat.description: The Stat it raises for good.

name.description: The Skill it raises for good, by name.

buff.description: Adds a Buff when it is used.

effects.description: What the Buff gives, never another Buff.

duration.description: Lasts: how long the Buff lasts, in words.

cures.description: Cures: the Debuffs it ends, each a stock Debuff's id or a name.

debuff.description: A Debuff using it adds: a stock Debuff's id, a name, or a homebrew Debuff's copy.

poison.description: Poison for a blade: it coats a weapon and is never drunk.

bonusLevel.description: Poison bonus level: on an Amazing Success with the coated weapon, the target is Poisoned at this much a round.

cast.description: Casts a Spell at a set Rank, as a scroll does.

rank.description: The Rank it is cast at.

explode.description: Explodes when thrown: an explosive's damage, Blast, Splash and Debuff. Using it opens the Throw sheet.

dice.description: Dice of damage. 0 deals none, and the Debuff still goes on everyone caught.

die.description: The damage die. Left out, d6.

damageType.description: The damage type it deals.

blastFeet.description: Blast: the area round where it lands, in feet.

splashFeet.description: Splash, in feet, beyond the Blast (or round the target with no Blast): everyone in it takes half the damage.

debuff.description: A Debuff it puts on everyone caught: a stock Debuff's id, a name, or a homebrew Debuff's copy.

attacks.description: Which attacks it rides on: ranged, melee, any, or thrown (a weapon thrown with the Thrown chip, or an item thrown from the Hotlist or inventory).

only.description: Only these Attack Skills, by name. Left out, it rides on every attack of that kind.

occasion.description: When: always adds it to every such attack; choose adds it each time the player chooses.

riders.description: What it adds to those attacks' rolls on a hit. The app rolls exactly these.

use.description: The macro and when it fires. A weapon's macro fires on its attacks while it is equipped, as its trigger says.

Effect.description: One effect: everything a NestedEffect can be, plus an inherent Spell, a Buff, a percent Stat bonus, what using up an item does, a ride-on and a weapon's macro.

id.description: The id of the Debuff it was copied from.

name.description: The Debuff's name. A Debuff already on with the same name, whatever its case, counts as the same one.

image.description: The Debuff's picture: a stock image id (stock:name) or the 43-character id of an uploaded image.

duration.description: Duration: rules text shown with it. Use clearedBy or rounds to end it by itself; this text alone never clears it.

notes.description: What it does, in the words the player reads.

checkPenalty.description: Check penalty: added to every Check while it is on. Write a penalty as a negative number (-2).

rollMode.description: Disadvantage on all Checks while it is on.

moveHalved.description: Move halved. On a Mob the app halves its Move; on a Crawler's sheet it shows as a reminder and the Move number stays as it is.

stackable.description: Stackable: taking it again adds another. Left out, taking it again refreshes the one already on and resets its rounds.

clearedBy.description: Cleared by: the least rest that ends it, short, long or fullDay (a Full Day's Rest). Left out, no rest ends it.

effects.description: What the sheet reads while it is on: Stat, Skill, Move, Step, DR, damage response, roll mode and damage bonus effects.

tick.description: Damage at the end of each round, rolled by the app.

dice.description: Damage each round: the dice, like 1d6 or 2d8.

plusFloor.description: Plus the Floor: adds the Floor number to each round's damage.

damageType.description: The damage's type, so Resistance and the like apply. Left out, untyped.

bonus.description: Extra damage each round, a flat amount.

restriction.description: Restricts Actions: attackAndMove (Attack and Move only), noActions, loseNextAction or noMove (no Move or Step). On a Crawler the app warns; on a Mob, noMove sets its Move to 0.

attacksAgainst.description: Attacks against whoever carries it have Advantage.

rounds.description: Ends after this many rounds, counted down at the end of each round.

families.description: Belongs to: a Crawler or Mob immune to one of these families is immune to this Debuff.

blocks.description: The damage it blocks: all damage, non-magic damage or magic damage.

lasts.description: How long the shield lasts: a number of rounds or minutes, or until ended.

byRank.description: The shield's slots from an Upgrade on, replacing the base.

spell.description: What makes it a Spell. A Spell needs one.

shield.description: A shield a Skill that is not a Spell gives its user, or one Crawler they pick: when used without a roll, or on a success. A Spell's goes in its spell block.

mod.description: A Stat whose Mod gives the number, read from the caster at cast time and kept in the shield.

slots.description: How many slots the shield has: a fixed number, or a Stat Mod.

fixed.description: A fixed value for each slot.

value.description: Value of each slot: the damage it takes to break one. A hit breaks a slot per full value, and whatever is left below the next slot's value is stopped.

blocks.description: The damage it blocks: all damage, non-magic damage or magic damage.

lasts.description: How long the shield lasts: a number of rounds or minutes, or until ended.

covers.description: Who gets it: self, one Crawler the user chooses, or area (the user and allies in the area, a Spell's only).

byRank.description: The shield's slots from an Upgrade on, replacing the base.

value.description: The size as a number, on the same scale as a Crawler's.

size.description: Its size, in the same shape a Race's Build gives a Crawler.

level.description: Level. A Mob (not a Boss) has a Health slot per Level, up to ten, and its Stat budget grows with it.

homeFloor.description: Home Floor: the Floor it was built for. Marked a visitor at a table on another Floor, it keeps its home Floor's numbers, DR included.

con.description: Constitution. Its Mod is each Health slot's value, unless the Mob is a vehicle.

stats.description: Its five Stats, as scores. Each attack adds its own Stat's Mod.

overrides.description: Computed numbers and overrides: leave one out to use the book's number.

surprise.description: Replaces 10 + the Int Mod; the Floor is still added.

evade.description: Replaces 10 + the Dex Mod; the Floor is still added.

drBonus.description: DR bonus, added to the Floor's DR (or a vehicle's own): +1 or +2 for armour, -1 or -2 for a spellcaster.

healthSlots.description: Replaces the Health slots its Level, Boss tier or vehicle would give.

slotValue.description: Replaces each Health slot's value, the Con Mod or a vehicle's size.

vehicle.description: For a Mob that is a vehicle, such as a war rig: its vehicle numbers. A vehicle has ten Health slots of its size and does not Evade.

move.description: The vehicle's Move, roughly miles per hour.

size.description: The vehicle's size: each of its ten Health slots holds this much.

dr.description: The vehicle's DR, used in place of the Floor's.

occupancy.description: Seats: everyone aboard, the driver included.

attacks.description: Its attacks. To hit is 10 + the Stat Mod + the Floor; damage is the dice + the Stat Mod.

damageType.description: The damage type it responds to.

response.description: resistance halves the damage after DR, immunity stops it, vulnerability doubles it.

damageResponses.description: Damage responses: how it takes a damage type.

debuffImmunities.description: Debuff immunity: a Debuff it is immune to is never placed on it. Only the GM sees it.

type.description: debuffImmunity (one Debuff) or debuffFamilyImmunity (a family of Debuffs, or all of them).

debuff.description: The Debuff it is immune to: a stock Debuff's id or a Debuff's name.

family.description: The Debuff family it is immune to (mindControl, fear, poison), or all for every Debuff.

id.description: The ability's id, unique among the Mob's abilities.

animation.description: The animation it plays on the Mob's token when the GM uses it. Left out, none plays.

abilities.description: Abilities: the tricks a stat block names, a name and what it does.

notes.description: Notes: what Look for Clues turns up.

kind.description: What drops: box (a Loot box), item, or text (anything with no piece behind it, for the GM to hand out).

boxId.description: The id of a Loot box in this file.

id.description: The row's id, unique in this Mob's loot.

id.description: The attack's id, unique among the attacks beside it.

stat.description: The Stat whose Mod goes on its to-hit and its damage.

diceCount.description: How many damage dice it rolls, or none for an attack that deals no damage (a grab, a web); its die and damage type are then ignored.

damageType.description: The damage type it deals.

mixedWith.description: Mixed with: a second damage type the damage splits evenly with.

range.description: Range, in words: melee, 30 ft, reach 10 ft.

area.description: The attack's Area of Effect, for one that hits everyone in it. Never a Wall.

shape.description: The area's shape: a Blast (from the target), a Burst (from the user), a Line (5 ft wide) or a Cone (both from the user), a Splash only, or a Wall placed within range.

feet.description: The area's size in feet. Every shape but a Splash only and a Wall has one.

splashFeet.description: A Splash beyond the area, in feet: the target takes full damage and everyone else in the Splash half. A Splash only area has this alone.

drifts.description: Drifts on a miss: a miss still lands somewhere, 1d8 for direction, as many feet away as it missed by.

sparesAllies.description: Spares allies: only enemies are caught in it.

endsIn.description: A Blast centred on the far end of a Line or a Cone. Anyone in both parts is hit once.

shape.description: The shape at the far end; only a Blast for now.

length.description: A Wall's length in feet. A ring's length goes round its centre.

height.description: A Wall's height in feet, shown and never used in play.

thickness.description: A Wall's thickness in feet: how many feet someone passing straight through crosses.

onFail.description: Debuffs the target gains on a Major Fail or worse at Evade: each a stock Debuff's id, the id of a Debuff in this file, or your own words. A pet's attack ignores them.

onFailMode.description: one: only one of the onFail Debuffs lands, the attacker's pick. Left out, all of them. A pet's attack ignores it.

onHit.description: On a hit: one Debuff the target gains on any failed Evade, with or without damage.

debuff.description: The Debuff: a stock Debuff's id, a homebrew Debuff's id, or your own words.

rounds.description: How many rounds it lasts. Left out, the Debuff's own length.

debuffsCountAs.description: Its Debuffs count as: the families every Debuff it lands belongs to, beside the Debuff's own. An immunity to the family stops it.

notes.description: Notes: anything else about the attack.

toHit.description: To-hit override: replaces 10 + the Stat Mod; the Floor is still added. A pet's attack ignores it.

damageBonus.description: Damage bonus override: replaces the Stat Mod on its damage.

plusFloor.description: + Floor: adds the Floor to its damage, as in 1d4+F.

sound.description: The sound it plays: stock: and a sound the app ships, piece: and a Sound piece's id, or stock:none for silence. Left out, the usual sound.

animation.description: The animation it plays. Left out, the app picks one.

spell.description: A Spell: its hits count as magic damage against a Crawler's shields. A pet's attack ignores it.

macros.description: Macros it fires on a Crawler it hits, each a whole copy of the macro with when it fires. A pet's attack never fires them.

diceCount.description: How many dice it rolls: a number, floor for as many as the table's Floor Number (the book's rule), or none for a story trap that deals no damage.

damageType.description: The damage type, named with the damage. Left out, none is named.

debuffId.description: The Debuff a Crawler gains when it fails to avoid the trap: a stock Debuff's id or the id of a Debuff in this file.

avoid.description: The Check a Crawler rolls to avoid it once it springs. By default Evade against the Floor's Unopposed number.

skill.description: Avoid with: the Skill rolled, by name. With Evade a Near Miss still avoids it and a Major or Critical Fail hurts more; any other Skill needs a success.

difficulty.description: The Difficulty to beat. Left out, the Floor's Unopposed number at the table.

readAloud.description: Read to players: shown to the Crawlers it catches when it springs.

animation.description: The animation it plays on the Crawlers it catches. Left out, a hit of its damage type plays, or nothing for a trap that deals no damage.

mimic.description: It's a Mimic: the chest is a Mob in disguise. When it is opened, the Mob is revealed.

mobId.description: The Mob that waits in the chest, by its id. When it is opened, the GM can add it to the table where the chest stood.

x.description: Where it sits across the map, in the image's pixels.

y.description: Where it sits down the map, in the image's pixels.

regionId.description: The region that hides it: players see it once that region is revealed. Left out, players always see it.

chestSpots.description: Where the Floor chests of the room this map is tied to sit on it, one spot per chest.

chestId.description: The Floor chest's id. Its contents and lock are set on the Floor map; opening it here opens it there too.
